author: (Simroth, 1895)

familyName.es: Babosas de mar chupadoras de savia

note.en: A 1 cm sap-sucking slug with an eye-like spot on each side, recorded on the Manzanillo and Cahuita shores in 2001 and 2002.
note.es: Una babosa de 1 cm chupadora de savia, con una mancha parecida a un ojo a cada lado, registrada en las orillas de Manzanillo y Cahuita en 2001 y 2002.

evidence: GBIF: 2 museum specimens, Manzanillo and the Cahuita reef, 2001 and 2002

sources.t: WoRMS / MolluscaBase: valid name and distribution
